## README.md
# OBIS: Ocean Biodiversity Information System

Rehosting of public OBIS data snapshots in parquet serialization. 

- See https://obis.org/data/access/ for details
- License: CC0.  

## Additional formats/derived layers:

- `obis_h3.parquet`

Obis 2024-06 snapshot, with additional [H3 Indexing](https://h3geo.org/) for spatial coordinates, resolutions 1-9, produced using duckdb+h3.
